title: Data Scientist
text:
Data Scientist

We are looking for a Data Scientist to build predictive models that drive product and business decisions.

Responsibilities
- Build, evaluate and deploy machine learning models (classification, regression, forecasting)
- Analyze large datasets with Python, pandas and SQL
- Design A/B tests and communicate results to stakeholders
- Create dashboards and data visualizations

Requirements
- 2+ years of experience in data science or machine learning
- Strong Python, pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn
- Solid SQL and statistics
- Experience with feature engineering and model evaluation
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or related field

Nice to have
- Deep learning with TensorFlow or PyTorch
- Experience with Spark, MLOps or cloud platforms (AWS, GCP)
- NLP or time series forecasting

title: Python Backend Developer

Nice to have

- Microservices architecture
